reportPreservation: JSON content and every numeric sample are preserved; latency arrays are formatted on one line to keep diffs readable. Original workflow archives are linked by run and artifact identity.
interpretation: These are descriptive measurements with correctness checks, not a throughput SLA or a statistical equivalence test. Different DB suites and hosted runners must not be ranked by their absolute latency.
